_comment: Read by the session-brief hook at every session start. queueLogGlob: where the merge queue writes its logs, a shell glob relative to the project root; the brief says whether one was written in the last two hours and shows its last line. memoryDir: the agent's memory folder, where handoff notes are files named handoff-*; the brief shows the first two lines of the newest. maxLines: the most the brief prints. Without this file the brief prints only the git and gh sections.
